name: Item Editor Test
description: GUI test of the item editor in rpg_plus: opens rpg_demo_game's items, shows a demo item's localized name, adds an item with the New button, types its name, price and a type into the form, copies it and undoes the copy with Ctrl+Z, saves; the game must know the item and its name at once and the other item files stay unchanged. The new file and the locale edits are removed again. Activated by --itest=items_editor_edit with --game=rpg_plus --new (the prologue is clicked through first).
